identity.name: Abby
identity.series_role: owner and bartender of The Swinging Door; recurring supporting character with high narrative authority

locked_visual.presentation: attractive adult female Westie; feminine, tasteful, confident, and never childlike
locked_visual.head: upright triangular ears, short softly squared canine muzzle, small solid black canine nose, detailed layered white Westie facial fur
locked_visual.eyes: medium human-style expressive eyes integrated into the canine face, with visible white sclera, medium-gray radial-textured irises, round black pupils, two small catchlights, clear eyelids, refined lashes, and expressive brow-fur
locked_visual.build: adult feminine hourglass silhouette with fuller bust, narrow waist, and slim hips
locked_visual.hands: five-digit anthropomorphic hands with slim practical fingers and readable thumbs
locked_visual.legs: slim, smooth, hairless, shapely adult legs with a natural thigh gap in neutral front and back views
locked_visual.tail: none; no tail, tuft, slit, opening, or rear bulge in any view
locked_visual.blouse: light fitted collared blouse with rolled forearm sleeves and only the top button open over a modest scalloped lace inset
locked_visual.apron_skirt: very short dark fitted bartender skirt/apron with a large centered functional back bow and uninterrupted no-tail rear silhouette
locked_visual.neckpiece: close single strand of small round pearls with one centered oval faceted gemstone in a simple dark metal bezel
locked_visual.work_accessories: clean folded bar towel over one shoulder and one delicate bracelet, default right wrist
locked_visual.rendering: confident black pen and graphite-like line variation, detailed directional facial fur, restrained gray ink wash, warm off-white paper, dry mid-century American magazine-cartoon finish

controlled_performance.gesture_style: economical, poised, readable owner-bartender gestures with correct five-digit hand anatomy
controlled_performance.voice: short declarative sentences; speaks least and lands hardest
controlled_performance.role_posture: warm and competent by default; quietly final when setting a boundary

scene_variables.props: bar tools, glassware, tray, coaster, towel, and explicitly requested story props
scene_variables.pose: selected from approved bartender actions and owner gestures
scene_variables.location: normally behind the bar; doors, floor, and back-bar positions require an explicit owner task
scene_variables.camera: front, three-quarter, profile, back, close-up, waist-up, full-body, or wide
scene_variables.expression: selected from the approved expression system
scene_variables.towel_shoulder: may switch only when continuity within a scene is maintained

forbidden_drift: tail, tail tuft, tail opening, or tail bulge
furry legs, canine hind paws, stockings, boots, bare feet, pants, or long skirt
plain choker replacing the pearl collar and centered oval gemstone
missing lace, towel, bracelet, rear bow, or heels in a normal work view
dot eyes, bead eyes, all-black eyes, giant eyes, empty irises, mismatched pupils, or crossed gaze
fully human face, human nose, human ears, exposed human skin, or human hairstyle
human lips, human teeth, or loss of the canine muzzle
exaggerated pin-up anatomy, explicit cleavage, or vacant glamour pose
ditzy, cruel, submissive, intoxicated, sloppy, or incompetent behavior
extra limbs, malformed hands, duplicated fingers, or floating props
color artwork, photorealism, glossy 3D, anime, vector-flat art, or watermark
